editorial.blurb: Ranalli's Pizza Bar crafts some of Chicago's best tavern-style pizza with a crunchy crust and carefully sourced ingredients, backed by genuinely warm service.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive ready to sit at the bar if the patio is packed—there's plenty of first-come, first-serve seating there, and it's a great spot to watch the pizza action. Don't skip the sweet potato fries.

topDishes.note: Habanero BBQ sauce delivers zesty, balanced heat
Crispy, generously portioned, and genuinely craveable
